context: A boss reviews a corporate crisis
purpose: Teach: 波紋/強める/独学/民意/隆盛/不規則/収拾/山手線

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界全体に波紋、急いで対応せねば。
lines.en: We're seeing ripples across the industry. We need to move on this quickly.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Sharp attack on the opening statement. Lean forward slightly — this is urgent but controlled. No fluff. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報、メッセージを強める方針です。
lines.en: Yes. PR is moving to strengthen our message.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Keeping pace with his boss. Not performing — reporting. Steady eye contact. The rhythm of someone in sync with what's being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手社員、独学でリスク管理、勉強している。
lines.en: Our junior staff are working through risk management on their own time. That's good.
lines.style: Observational, approving. Slight lift on 「独学」 — not criticism, noting initiative. Measured pace. The tone of someone noticing competence and choosing to acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。民意の動き、SNSモニタリングしています。
lines.en: Yes. We're monitoring social media — tracking where public sentiment is moving.
lines.style: Factual, reassuring. Delivered as if checking boxes, but with quiet confidence. No hesitation. The report of someone who has already thought ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の隆盛、油断するな。
lines.en: The competition is moving. Don't lose focus.
lines.style: Sharp, final. A light warning without lecturing. Crisp consonants. The tone that lands because it's brief and because he means it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 不規則な情報流出、収拾、急いでいます。
lines.en: We're working to contain the information leaks. It's urgent.
lines.style: Steady but with underlying strain. Slight acceleration — not panicked, but the pace shows pressure. The candor of someone admitting the situation is harder than it looks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社、山手線沿線への移転、検討しろ。
lines.en: Look into relocating headquarters to the Yamanote area.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-looking. Plant the statement — this is not a suggestion. Calm conviction. The tone of someone already thinking three moves ahead.
